newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Light to boost substrate MD output.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Light to boost substrate MD output.

text.p: Integrated aluminium producer Nippon Light Metal Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would invest about seven billion yen to boost its output of aluminium substrate memory discs to 5.5 million units a month in 1998.
Nippon Light Metal currently produces 3.2 million of the memory discs, which are used to make hard disc drives, a month.

The company already has plans to boost production to 4.2 million units a month by the autumn, and the seven billion yen investment will be used to further increase output to 5.5 million units a month in 1998, the company said in a statement.
Nippon Light Metal said it would improve existing production facilities at its Tomakomai plant in Hokkaido, northern Japan, and build a new production line at the plant.
The upgrading of the existing facilities will be completed by the end of next January and the construction of the new line will be completed by the end of next April, the company said.
